inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The contribution-positioning text names the comparison set, states the distinct unit of contribution, labels adaptations versus synthesis, and makes no unsupported global novelty claim.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A reader-visible contribution-positioning passage identifies the closest comparison set, states the manuscript's distinct unit of contribution relative to that set, distinguishes adaptations from synthesis, and confines novelty language to what the stated comparison supports.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript supplies a genuine comparison or contribution distinction but leaves at least one inherited element unresolved, such as an unnamed comparison set, an unstated distinct contribution unit, no adaptation-versus-synthesis labeling, or novelty language broader than the comparison supports.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A change is a regression if it makes the closest-work comparison or contribution distinction less explicit, removes adaptation-versus-synthesis qualification, or broadens novelty language beyond the comparison-supported scope relative to the original manuscript.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Every artifact invoked as an audit basis has a stable locator, version or content digest, access condition, and explicit claim-surface relationship, or the auditability claim is narrowed to what readers can actually inspect.

operationalization.fully_addressed: For every artifact invoked as an audit basis, the manuscript provides a stable locator, a version or content digest, its access condition, and its explicit relationship to the manuscript claim surface; alternatively, every auditability statement is narrowed so it covers only artifacts and relationships that readers can actually inspect.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript provides genuine artifact-access or manifest information, or narrows some auditability language, but at least one invoked audit-basis artifact still lacks a stable locator, version or digest, access condition, or claim-surface relationship while remaining within the auditability claim.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A change is a regression if it removes or weakens reader-accessible artifact identification, version or digest information, access conditions, or claim-surface links, or expands auditability claims to additional material that readers cannot inspect relative to the original manuscript.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The reported corpus counts replay from the disclosed row-level ledger, and the final 22 admitted identifiers are hash-linked to the evidence matrix without implying a broader search than was executed.

operationalization.fully_addressed: A disclosed row-level search-and-screening ledger records the executed sources or interfaces, dates, exact queries, raw identifiers, deduplication rules, and each inclusion or exclusion decision such that the reported corpus counts can be replayed; the final 22 admitted identifiers are hash-linked to the evidence matrix, and the manuscript's search-scope language does not exceed the executed search.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript or supplement discloses genuine search, deduplication, screening, or linkage evidence, but the reported counts are not fully replayable from row-level decisions, the 22 admitted identifiers are not hash-linked to the evidence matrix, or the stated search scope remains broader than the disclosed execution.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A change is a regression if it removes row-level search or screening provenance, breaks count replay or the hash link between the 22 admitted identifiers and evidence matrix, or broadens the claimed search beyond the disclosed execution relative to the original manuscript.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: Each decision-bearing source-role claim either carries an exact passage locator, hypothesis map, and prohibited-transfer note or is explicitly narrowed while retaining an INCONCLUSIVE claim-to-passage status.

operationalization.fully_addressed: Each decision-bearing source-role claim follows one of the inherited alternatives: it is paired with an exact passage locator, a map of the source-local hypotheses, and a note identifying prohibited transfers, or the claim is explicitly narrowed and its claim-to-passage status remains INCONCLUSIVE.
operationalization.partially_addressed: After a genuine manuscript change, at least one decision-bearing source-role claim does not satisfy the complete exact-passage-locator, hypothesis-map, and prohibited-transfer-note branch and also fails at least one component of the alternative branch: explicit narrowing is absent or the INCONCLUSIVE claim-to-passage status is not retained.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A change is a regression if it broadens a decision-bearing source-role claim, removes an INCONCLUSIVE qualification, weakens a passage locator or hypothesis/prohibited-transfer mapping, or treats passage-unresolved material as resolved without the inherited evidence combination relative to the original manuscript.

inherited_criterion.roadmap_text: The prospective replay boundary states closed input and receipt schemas, verifier predicates, code-reuse constraints, fixture classes with expected outcomes, and the unchanged fact that no replay has been executed.

operationalization.fully_addressed: The prospective replay specification states closed input and receipt schemas, the verifier's acceptance predicates, producer-verifier code-reuse constraints, the named fixture classes with expected outcomes, and an explicit statement that no replay has been executed.
operationalization.partially_addressed: The manuscript gives a genuine prospective replay specification but leaves at least one inherited component absent or open-ended: closed input or receipt schemas, verifier predicates, code-reuse constraints, fixture classes with expected outcomes, or the explicit no-replay-executed statement.
operationalization.made_worse_discriminator: A change is a regression if it makes the replay boundary less closed or less independently checkable, removes a required predicate, constraint, fixture outcome, or no-execution qualification, or implies that replay occurred when it did not relative to the original manuscript.
